land_per_acre.label: Land price per acre, Boerne ETJ near I-10
land_per_acre.assumption: Set at about the 2026 asking-price level for ETJ land near I-10 in Boerne. The listing is not cited so that no real parcel is identified; it sits between the cited asks for a 2.56-acre I-10 lot and a 45.4-acre tract [^5,6]. An appraisal sets the value.

ffe_pu.label: Furniture, fixtures and equipment per unit

contingency_pct.label: Hard-cost contingency
contingency_pct.assumption: The research has no San Antonio cost index; Weitz's 2026 mid-level AL range of $281 to $358 per sq ft (city index 100, excluding sitework) sits above the CBRE hard cost [^46], so a contingency is carried until HUD's cost review.

draw_factor.label: Average share of the loan outstanding during the build
draw_factor.assumption: Loan draws rise from zero to the full loan, so about half is outstanding on average.

fee_pct.label: HUD application, inspection, lender, legal and title fees, share of the loan
fee_pct.assumption: The research gives a 0.3% application fee [^58] but no inspection, placement or legal fees for Section 232; 2.5% of the loan is a placeholder for the lender's fee schedule.

wc_pct.label: Working capital escrow, share of the loan

odr.label: Initial operating deficit escrow
odr.assumption: HUD sizes this escrow on Form HUD-91128-ORCF from the lease-up cash flows [^43]; the research gives no amount. The placeholder covers most of the Year 1 shortfall in this model and is replaced by the lender's calculation.

al_units.label: Assisted living units
al_units.assumption: The median AL/MC community has 83 units [^44]; the mix follows a recent 63 AL and 26 MC proposal and Franklin Park's own AL-heavy mix [^9].

mc_units.label: Memory care units
mc_units.assumption: About 29% of the 83 units, a secured wing; Franklin Park holds 38 Alzheimer beds among 96 licensed [^9].

al_rate.label: Assisted living monthly rate with care, Year 1
al_rate.assumption: No operator posts rates. Local quotes run $3,930 to $6,430 at Franklin Park [^10] and $4,534 for a one-bedroom in Fair Oaks Ranch [^24]; the South Central regional average fee with care was $5,658 in FY2024 [^44]. A new building prices near the top of the local range.

mc_rate.label: Memory care monthly rate with care, Year 1
mc_rate.assumption: Local memory care quotes run from $5,160 [^20] to $6,027 for a one-bedroom in Fair Oaks Ranch [^24]; the South Central regional memory care fee was $7,298 in FY2024 [^44]. A new secured wing prices above the older local stock.

rate_growth.label: Annual rate increase
rate_growth.assumption: Below the 5.3% in-place assisted living rate growth NIC MAP reported for June 2026 [^49], because a lease-up community discounts to fill.

occ.label: Average occupancy
occ.assumption: Lease-up follows an S-curve, with stabilization by years 3 to 4 in NIC's analysis [^50]. Stabilized occupancy of 88% sits below the 89.1% national assisted living rate for 3Q 2026 [^48] and above the 86.6% median for AL/MC communities in FY2024 [^44].

occ_stab.label: Stabilized occupancy used to size fixed costs
occ_stab.assumption: Same as the stabilized occupancy above.

core_ratio.label: Operating cost excluding management fee, property tax and reserves, share of revenue
core_ratio.assumption: Labor alone ran 47.2% of revenue at the median AL/MC community in FY2024, and total operating expense 77.7% including the management fee [^44]. The model holds 62% for labor, food, utilities, insurance, marketing and administration.

core_floor_share.label: Share of stabilized operating cost carried during lease-up
core_floor_share.assumption: A licensed community must staff and run the building before it fills; 70% of the stabilized cost is the floor.

tax_rate.label: Combined ETJ property tax rate (county, Boerne ISD, Cow Creek GCD), tax year 2025

reserve_pu.label: Replacement reserve per unit per year
reserve_pu.assumption: HUD sets the reserve for replacement in its firm commitment; the research has no figure.

hud_max_ltc.label: Maximum loan to cost, Section 232 new construction (secondary)

hud_max_ltv.label: Maximum loan to value, for-profit borrower, Section 232 new construction (secondary)

hud_rate.label: Note rate, fixed
hud_rate.assumption: The research has no dated Section 232 rate. The 10-year Treasury was 4.23% on March 11, 2026 [^60]; the model uses 6.00% fixed, set at rate lock

hud_mip_annual.label: Annual mortgage insurance premium, Section 232 new construction without tax credits

uses.label: Soft costs (design, permits, licensing, developer costs)
Construction-period interest and MIP
uses.basis: [^47] build period; on the average loan balance

uses.label: HUD, lender, legal and title fees

opex.label: Labor, food, utilities, insurance, marketing and administration
opex.expr: max(core_floor_share * core_ratio * 12 * (al_units * al_rate + mc_units * mc_rate) * occ_stab * (1 + rate_growth) ** y, core_ratio * rev_total)

opex.label: Property tax
opex.expr: (site_acres * land_per_acre + bldg_sf * hard_psf + (al_units + mc_units) * ffe_pu) * tax_rate

proposed.note: the sponsor proposes the maximum 90% loan to cost, leaving 10% equity

glance: Boerne, Kendall County, Texas, in the San Antonio metro, in the city's extraterritorial jurisdiction near the I-10 corridor [^1]
Hypothetical new-construction community: {in_al_units} assisted living and {in_mc_units} memory care units, {in_bldg_sf} sq ft on {in_site_acres} acres
